description: Land Title Settlement Department - Millathe, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511040
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for specific parcels in various locations. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and property encumbrances. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
